_comment: KID (Keyword Item Distributor, D-5). Emits <file>_KID.ini at the mod root — attaches a Keyword to matching records by filter at start-up, no ESP patch. An unknown keyword EditorID makes KID create a new KYWD. Requires KID.dll at runtime; KID resolves refs against the player's load order (ModForge only checks structure).
